faqs.question: What can CBZ Insurance cover?
faqs.answer: Motor, home and contents, travel and personal accident cover for individuals; business and commercial policies; and cover for crops, livestock and farm machinery.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Tell us what you want covered on the quote form. A consultant sends your quotation, usually within one working day.

faqs.question: How do I pay my premium?
faqs.answer: By direct debit from your CBZ account or by mobile money. You choose when you apply through Insure now.

faqs.question: How do I submit a claim?
faqs.answer: Use the claim form to tell us what happened, when, and any police report number. A claims assessor contacts you within two working days about the next steps and documents.

faqs.question: How do I renew, change or cancel a policy?
faqs.answer: The policy changes form handles policy status, renewals, cancellations, statements and premium enquiries. We come back to you, usually within one working day.

productsNote: Terms, pricing and availability are subject to assessment. Speak to us for current terms before you rely on anything here.
about: CBZ Insurance is the Group’s short-term insurer, covering individuals, businesses and farms. Motor, home, travel and accident cover for people; property, liability, marine and engineering cover for businesses; and crop, livestock and machinery cover for farmers. Cover can be arranged alongside a CBZ Bank facility, so an asset is protected from the day it is financed.
